title: The End of the Ten-Thousand-Year Chess Game
next_chapter_hook: "On the broken pages, the ancient characters began to flow slowly, as if an awareness dormant for ten thousand years had finally awakened. Chen Ji heard a withered, exhausted voice ring out in his Mental Sea: 'You've finally come, the one who will break the game.'"

text.content:
Chen Ji felt as if his blood had frozen solid.

Ye Qing's betrayal—no, it wasn't betrayal at all, it had been part of the 'Twin Destinies' plan from the very beginning. He thought he was the one laying out the pieces, never knowing that the Demonic Path commander had already made his moves before Chen Ji was even born. Cold sweat slid down his spine, soaking his inner robe. He took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. Bear grudges without acting rashly—this was the fundamental principle that had kept him alive in his servant position at the Tianqing Sect. The debt owed by Ye Qing, he recorded. The debt owed by the Demonic Path commander, he also recorded. But now was not the time for settling accounts—he had something more important to do.

dialogue.content: "Ye Qing... So that's how it is. The Twin Destinies plan, what an ambitious scheme."

text.content:
He slowly closed his eyes, submerging his consciousness into the depths of his Mental Sea. There floated a scroll of broken pages—the first page of the Tianji Record, where Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul waited quietly.

"Mo Xiansheng, I want to activate the Heavenly Eye."

The remnant soul trembled slightly: "The Heavenly Eye... Are you certain? Last time you used the Heavenly Eye to trace a truth from thirty years ago, your Heavenly Fate Value dropped by thirty points directly. Now your Heavenly Fate Value is less than a hundred points—using it again—"

"I know." Chen Ji interrupted him. "But I need to know the truth. All of it. The sacrifice ten thousand years ago, the Chen family ancestor, the Eye of Heavenly Secrets... everything."

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul fell silent for a moment, as if making some kind of assessment. Finally, he let out a sigh: "You child, you really are like him."

"Him?"

"Your ancestor." Mo Xiansheng's tone carried a trace of nostalgia. "Back then, he was the same way—even knowing the abyss lay ahead, he still jumped in without hesitation. Since your resolve is set, I'll lend you a hand—but remember, the Heavenly Eye only lets you see the truth. How you choose to act after seeing the truth clearly is your own affair."

The remnant soul transformed into a streak of light and merged into Chen Ji's brow center. In an instant, his consciousness broke free from the shackles of his physical body, gazing down upon the ten-thousand-year vicissitudes of this cultivation world from a perspective that transcended time.

He saw it.

Ten thousand years ago, the world was still a realm of chaos, Spiritual Energy as abundant as an ocean. In those earliest of times, the Eye of Heavenly Secrets had already existed—it was neither god nor human, but a transcendent will, an instinct craving eternal order. It viewed the world as a chessboard and all things as chess pieces.

dialogue.content: (Scenes from ten thousand years ago flooded into Chen Ji's consciousness like a tide)... Trillions of living beings, all chess pieces. Only the Prophet can peer into the Heavenly Secrets.

text.content:
He saw the Eye of Heavenly Secrets begin to lay out its chess game.

It needed chess pieces—pieces capable of peering into Heavenly Secrets and divining the future. So it created the Tianji Record, a scroll of fate written in fragments, scattered across the mortal world in countless pages. Each generation, it selected one Prophet, implanting one page of the Tianji Record into their Mental Sea. These Prophets believed themselves to be the chosen ones, never knowing they were merely selected sacrifices.

The more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger the Prophet's abilities, but the shorter their lifespan. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets needed these Prophets to constantly peer into the Heavenly Secrets, firmly keeping the trajectory of fate under its control.

Then he saw the Chen family ancestor—the first Prophet of the Chen bloodline.

That was a young man with refined features, his brow carrying a sharpness similar to Chen Ji's. A page of the Tianji Record had been implanted in his Mental Sea, making him the Prophet of that generation.

But this young man was different from the others.

When other Prophets indulged in the pleasure of peering into Heavenly Secrets, he began contemplating a dangerous question: Why? Why must I divine fate for the Eye of Heavenly Secrets? Where did the Tianji Record come from? And where did the Eye of Heavenly Secrets itself come from?

Chen Ji saw the ancestor begin secretly researching the origin of the Tianji Record.

He discovered a terrifying truth—the Eye of Heavenly Secrets was not native to this world. It came from a higher dimension. It descended upon this world to search for something: a seed containing the 'Primordial Power.'

That seed was the primordial force that had existed since the birth of this world. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets wished to devour it, allowing itself to evolve into an existence of a higher order. And the Prophets' mission was to help it find the whereabouts of that seed.

But the Eye of Heavenly Secrets made a mistake.

It did not know that when Prophets continuously used the Tianji Record, they would gradually merge with it. The stronger their ability to peer into Heavenly Secrets, the higher their compatibility with the Tianji Record. And when this compatibility reached its extreme, the Prophet would possess the qualification to dialogue with the Eye of Heavenly Secrets.

During a deep meditation, the Chen family ancestor 'saw' the本体 of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets—a colossal eye spanning the Void, surrounded by countless smaller eyes, each one watching over every blade of grass in the world.

The ancestor saw the weakness of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets.

It was not invincible. Although it came from a higher dimension, it was bound by this world's rules. It could not directly interfere with worldly affairs; it could only manipulate the trajectory of fate through Prophets and the Tianji Record. It needed humans as its eyes and hands.

More importantly—it was afraid.

Afraid that the 'Primordial Seed' would be found first by someone else, afraid that someone might threaten its existence. That was why it had been so cautious in laying out countless chess pieces in the world, smothering all factors that could threaten it in their cradle.

dialogue.content: (From the ancestor's perspective) ...So that's how it is. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets, you are merely an invader from another dimension. Why should this world's fate be handed over to you for manipulation?

text.content:
Chen Ji saw the ancestor make a crazy decision.

Ten thousand years ago, the predecessors of the three great Sects jointly held a grand sacrifice ceremony. They planned to use the blood essence of ten thousand cultivators as offerings to activate a 'Divine Artifact' said to be capable of communicating with heaven. That Divine Artifact was actually bait投放 by the Eye of Heavenly Secrets—it wanted to take this opportunity to eliminate all cultivators who might threaten it in one sweep.

But the ancestor saw through this trap.

He did not stop the ceremony. Instead, he chose another way.

At the most critical moment of the ceremony, he suddenly struck out, forcibly剥离 the first page of the Tianji Record from his Mental Sea. In that instant, his soul felt as if it were being torn apart, blood pouring from his seven apertures. But he still did not stop, exerting all his strength to tear that page of the Tianji Record in half.

One half was returned to the Eye of Heavenly Secrets.

The other half, he sealed within his own bloodline.

Chen Ji's consciousness shook violently.

He saw it!

With the price of his life, the ancestor had merged a small fragment of the Tianji Record into the Chen bloodline. It was not the complete Tianji Record, only a seed—a 'Breaking-the-Game Seed.'

It would not grant its host the ability to foresee the future, nor would it make the host a chess piece of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. Its sole purpose was to wait. Wait for the bloodline to pass down to a descendant strong enough, so that seed could take root and sprout, growing into a force capable of breaking the shackles.

dialogue.content: (A monstrous wave crashed through Chen Ji's heart) ...I, I am not some heaven-chosen Prophet. I am... a Breaking-the-Game Seed? My existence, from the very beginning, was meant to break the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' control?

text.content:
The Heavenly Eye continued to extend backward, and Chen Ji saw more.

He saw that over ten thousand years, the Chen bloodline had been passed down generation after generation, that seed always slumbering in the depths of the bloodline. Some had extraordinary talent, some were mediocre, but no one could awaken it.

Until Chen Ji was born.

He saw the Eye of Heavenly Secrets take notice of Chen Ji. When Chen Ji was still an infant, that colossal eye spanning the Void had 'looked' at him. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets discovered the abnormality in his bloodline, but because the seed was far too weak, it chose to observe.

When Chen Ji was three years old, a wandering monk passing by saw him.

That monk was actually a messenger of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. Upon discovering an anomalous species hidden within the Chen bloodline, he reported it to the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. Thus, the Eye of Heavenly Secrets made a decision—to implant another page of the Tianji Record into Chen Ji's Mental Sea.

It wanted to use the Tianji Record to suppress the Breaking-the-Game Seed, turning Chen Ji into another obedient chess piece.

But it never expected that the seed had long merged with Chen Ji's soul. The implantation of the Tianji Record instead provided the seed with an opportunity to grow.

Chen Ji saw the true origin of his 'waste' persona.

It wasn't that he was born with mediocre talent, but that the Eye of Heavenly Secrets had placed a seal within his body. Whenever he tried to break through a realm, the seal would automatically suppress his cultivation, making him appear as a废物.

And the reason he could acquire the ability to foresee the future was because the Tianji Record had produced some kind of resonance with the Breaking-the-Game Seed. Every time he used this ability, his Heavenly Fate Value would be consumed—in truth, that was consuming the power he needed to break his shackles.

He saw the seven-hundred-chapter death prophecy.

That was not an arrangement of fate, but a safety mechanism set by the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. As long as Chen Ji's 'death countdown' had not reached zero, all his actions would remain within the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' control. No matter how he struggled, he would ultimately walk toward that destined conclusion.

Unless—

He could find a way to break the shackles before death descended.

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye continued to trace back, and Chen Ji saw the secret of the Tianji Record's true body—the complete Tianji Record consisted of ninety-nine pages, each page a shackle. But the ninety-ninth page contained the key to breaking all shackles. Only that page was hidden by the Eye of Heavenly Secrets in the deepest reaches of fate, utterly unreachable by ordinary means. At this moment, the choice before you is:

choices.text: Continue tracing back, consuming Heavenly Fate Value
choices.description: Push the Heavenly Eye to its limit, forcibly peer into the location of the ninety-ninth page. However, this will consume a massive amount of Heavenly Fate Value, and your death countdown will advance significantly.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the Key Clue to the Ninety-Ninth Page
choices.risk_hint: Death Countdown Accelerated by at Least Thirty Chapters

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth, pushing the Heavenly Eye to its limit. Something in his Mental Sea seemed to be burning, intense pain spreading from his Brow Center throughout his entire body. His Heavenly Fate was draining frantically, the seven-hundred-chapter death countdown seemingly pressed on a fast-forward button. But he still saw it—the Ninety-Ninth Page was hidden within the Heaven's Eye's main body. To obtain it, he must face that giant eye spanning the Void.

Heavenly Fate: Current 50/100 (50 points consumed)
Death Countdown: Accelerated by Thirty Chapters

choices.text: Temporarily Retract the Heavenly Eye, Preserve Strength
choices.description: You have already obtained enough truth. Excessive consumption will only make the situation more passive. Better to take a step back and plan carefully.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily Give Up Obtaining More Information
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Heavenly Fate, Maintain Current Situation

text.content:
Chen Ji suddenly withdrew his consciousness, the Heavenly Eye's vision receded like a tide. Intense vertigo struck him, forcing him to grip the stone pillar to steady himself. Mo Xiansheng's surprised voice echoed in his Mental Sea: "You actually pulled back at such a moment? I thought you would continue investigating."

"Take it easy." Chen Ji wiped the blood from his mouth corner, a cold smile forming, "I've discovered I'm the Breaking the Game Seed. Whether it's the Heaven's Eye's insurance mechanism or the seven-hundred-chapter death prophecy—as long as I exist, it won't rest peacefully."

Just as Chen Ji contemplated how to confront the Heaven's Eye, a sudden change occurred.

The Tianji Record in his Mental Sea suddenly vibrated violently. That rolled fragment unfolded on its own, golden light bursting from between the characters, condensing into a blurry figure in the Void.

That figure was extremely old, as if having endured endless years. Its features were unclear, yet Chen Ji felt an inexplicable sense of familiarity—a sensation like looking into a mirror.

A withered voice resonated in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, carrying the weariness of ages:

"I am the Tianji Record's main body. Or rather, I am the part severed by the Heaven's Eye. Ten thousand years ago, your ancestor integrated my fragments into your bloodline. From that moment, I have been waiting."

"Waiting for what?"

"A person capable of breaking the shackles." The Tianji Record's main body's voice held a glimmer of anticipation. "Your ancestor understood that the Heaven's Eye is not invincible. It fears those who dare to question and resist it. And you, Chen Ji—you are the game-breaker I've awaited for ten thousand years."

Chen Ji did not respond immediately, rapidly analyzing the statement's credibility.

The Tianji Record's sudden appearance must have its purpose. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul lingered in a corner of his Mental Sea. Chen Ji silently passed an inquiring gaze. Mo Xiansheng slightly nodded, seemingly saying: "What it says is true."

But does truth matter? In this ten-thousand-year-old chess game, no one is entirely trustworthy. The Heaven's Eye is his enemy, and the Tianji Record's main body may not be his ally. The ancestor integrated the Breaking the Game Seed into the bloodline to break shackles. But what if this itself is another trap?

"You claim to be the part severed by the Heaven's Eye." Chen Ji slowly spoke. "What is your relationship with the Heaven's Eye?"

The Tianji Record's main body's voice carried a trace of bitterness: "I am what the Heaven's Eye fears most. The Heaven's Eye originates from higher dimensions, seeking to devour this world's primordial power for evolution. And I happen to be part of that primordial power—or rather, the 'backdoor' left behind by primordial power."

"Backdoor?"

"Every system has vulnerabilities." The Tianji Record's main body stated. "Though the Heaven's Eye is powerful, it is not perfect. It can control destiny, yet cannot control the possibility of 'breaking destiny'. And I am the embodiment of that possibility."

Chen Ji's pupils suddenly contracted.

He understood.

The Tianji Record's main body was not some mysterious treasure, but the Heaven's Eye's 'vulnerability'. It existed within the Heaven's Eye's system yet was not controlled by the Heaven's Eye. The Heaven's Eye continuously attempted to find and destroy it, yet always failed—because it hid within destiny's folds, within the bloodlines of every prophet it had used.

Ten thousand years ago, an ancestor discovered this secret. He did not choose to completely destroy the Tianji Record (because he could not), but instead chose to integrate some of its seeds into his bloodline, allowing it to pass through generations, waiting for someone powerful enough to emerge.

dialogue.content: (The Tianji Record's main body continued)... The Ninety-Ninth Page is my final key. It can break all shackles imposed by the Heaven's Eye, including the seal on your aptitude. But to obtain it, you must confront the Heaven's Eye—that will be the final battle determining this world and heaven's fate.

choice.prompt: The Tianji Record's main body revealed a shocking truth: the Heaven's Eye is not invincible, but to defeat it, three conditions must be met. First, your cultivation must reach the peak of Yuan Ying (Nascent Soul) or above. Second, you must gather the ninety-nine scattered fragments of the Tianji Record. Third, you must find the other 'Destiny Twin' and join forces with her to break the situation. What you lack most now is not strength, not fragments, but—time. The Destiny Twins' plan has already begun, and your time is running out.

choices.description: The Destiny Twins require two people to join forces to break the situation. Since Ye Qing is the other part of the plan, finding her and persuading her becomes the most urgent task. Even if she once 'betrayed' you, once the truth is revealed, everything will be different.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the Other Half of the Destiny Twins' Power
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing's True Allegiance Remains Unknown

text.content:
Chen Ji made his decision. He turned and flew toward where the Demon Path army was stationed. Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in his Mental Sea: "Are you sure? Ye Qing's identity is complex—she is the Demon Path Saint, and behind her stands the shadow of the Holy Sect. Moreover, her 'betrayal' may truly be part of the plan—this means she may not stand on your side."

"I know." A sharp light flickered in Chen Ji's eyes, "But the Destiny Twins require two people to join forces—this is the necessary condition to break the situation. Ye Qing may have her own considerations, but she has no choice—as I have no choice either. We are both chess pieces. The only thing we can do is overturn the chessboard."

choices.memory_label: 决定寻找夜清联手破局

choices.description: Ye Qing can be found, but not now. The Fate Twins Plan has already begun, which means the Eye of Heavenly Dao is accelerating its layout. At this moment, the safest approach is to first increase strength, ensuring you have sufficient capital in this final confrontation.

text.content:
Chen Ji stopped in his tracks, his gaze turning deep.

He convinced himself: Ye Qing was not urgent to find. Since she was part of the Fate Twins Plan, she would inevitably appear at a critical moment. Rather than risking去找一个立场不明的盟友，不如先巩固自己的实力。

But what he failed to notice was that the instant he made this decision, in the depths of the Void, the ancient giant eye spanning millennia slightly rotated, as if gazing at all this. The corner of the Eye of Heavenly Dao seemed to勾起一丝不易察觉的弧度。

The chess game continued. And Chen Ji was stepping into its next trap.

Just then, the voice of the Tianji Record's main consciousness rang out again, carrying an unusual urgency:

"Chen Ji, there is one more thing you must know."

"Speak."

"The Eye of Heavenly Dao has already begun its actions. The Fate Twins Plan is only part of its scheme—its true purpose is to complete the final harvest on this generation's Prophet." The Tianji Record's voice grew solemn, "Do you know why the Prophet's lifespan shortens as the Tianji Record's completeness increases? Because every time you use the Tianji Record, part of your soul is devoured by the Eye of Heavenly Dao. When the soul is completely devoured—"

"The Prophet will die." Chen Ji interjected, his voice ice-cold, "And the soul after death becomes nourishment for the Eye of Heavenly Dao."

"Correct." The Tianji Record's main consciousness sighed, "For ten thousand years, countless Prophets have died in this trap. They thought they were using the Tianji Record, but in reality, they were feeding the Eye of Heavenly Dao. And you—"

"I am the most special one." Chen Ji冷笑，"Because I have the Seed of Breakthrough in my body, the Eye of Heavenly Dao cannot directly devour my soul. So it changed its method—seven hundred chapters of death prophecy, a predestined ending. It wants to kill me through fate itself."

"That is why you must break the局 as soon as possible." The Tianji Record's main consciousness said, "Your death countdown has begun to accelerate. Every time you use the Tianji Record's abilities, every glimpse of heavenly secrets, shortens that countdown. And once the Fate Twins Plan is complete, the Eye of Heavenly Dao will gain sufficient power—"

"Then it will personally end this chess game." Chen Ji接道，眼中闪过一丝寒光，"Including this undisciplined chess piece of mine."

Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the surging emotions.

He began to re-examine the entire picture of this ten-thousand-year chess game:

The Eye of Heavenly Dao, a high-dimensional invader, coveting the fundamental power of this world.

The Tianji Record, a tool used by the Eye of Heavenly Dao to manipulate fate, but part of it is its "vulnerability."

Chen Ji's ancestor, the first to discover the truth, buried the seed of rebellion in his bloodline through the Seed of Breakthrough.

And he himself is the fruit that seed waited ten thousand years to bear.

The Fate Twins Plan—is it the Eye of Heavenly Dao's killing move, or an opportunity to break the局? What role does Ye Qing play in this? Was her betrayal real, or does she have other secrets?

Just as Chen Ji fell into deep thought, a violent tremor suddenly came from the depths of his Mental Sea.

The Tianji Record Fragment suspended in his Mental Sea abruptly unfurled, golden light illuminating the entire Mental Sea.紧接着，一道苍老而疲惫的声音在陈机的灵魂深处响起：

"You have finally arrived, the Breaker of the局."

Chen Ji's pupils suddenly constricted—that was the voice of the Tianji Record's main consciousness. It was not at the edge of his Mental Sea, but had directly appeared in the deepest part of his soul.

"You are..." Chen Ji's voice tightened.

"I am the will of the Tianji Record, or rather, the final remnant of consciousness沉睡万载 in this fragment." That voice carried boundless vicissitudes, "I have waited a long time, for someone who could break the chains."

Chen Ji努力让自己的声音保持平静："How much do you know?"

"Everything." The Tianji Record's main consciousness carried a hint of bitterness, "Ten thousand years ago, the moment your ancestor integrated the Seed of Breakthrough into his bloodline, I began waiting. I am part of the Tianji Record, yet also the part abandoned by the Eye of Heavenly Dao. It considered me too dangerous, so it sealed me in the deepest part of this fragment."

"Then why are you only appearing now?"

"Because your Heavenly Fate value has dropped too low to支撑我现身。" The Tianji Record's main consciousness carried a hint of apology, "Every appearance consumes the host's life force. You are a smart person, should understand what this means."

Chen Ji沉默。

This meant the Tianji Record's main consciousness's appearance came at the cost of consuming his Heavenly Fate. Every time it appeared to speak, he stepped closer to death.

But wasn't this exactly what he had been doing all along? Trading Heavenly Fate for the ability to foresee the future, trading life for the capital to layout the world.

He had long been accustomed to dancing with death.

"Speak." Chen Ji raised his head, his eyes flashing with sharp brilliance, "What do you want to tell me?"

dialogue.content: (The Tianji Record's main consciousness slowly said)... The Eye of Heavenly Dao is not invincible. It has a weakness—its true body is hidden at the highest point of this world, called the "Apex of Heavenly Dao." That is the only place it cannot monitor, because monitoring is its mode of existence, but at the "Apex of Heavenly Dao," it can only "gaze" and cannot "interfere."

text.content:
Chen Ji's heart rate骤然加速。

The Apex of Heavenly Dao—that was a name he had never heard. It was not recorded in the Tianqing Sect's archives, the elders of the three major sects avoided the topic, and even Mo Xiansheng had never mentioned it. So it was not merely a legendary forbidden land, but the hiding place of the Eye of Heavenly Dao's true body.

"How to get there?" he asked.

"Three things are needed." The Tianji Record's main consciousness said, "First, all ninety-nine pages of the Tianji Record, which can open the portal to the Apex of Heavenly Dao once gathered. Second, the Fate Twins must both be present, because only by joining forces can you maintain your sense of self before it. Third—"

It paused, its voice becoming solemn: "A weapon capable of piercing a high-dimensional existence."

"What kind of weapon?"

"Left behind by your ancestor." The Tianji Record's main consciousness carried a hint of nostalgia, "Ten thousand years ago, knowing he could not defeat the Eye of Heavenly Dao, he merged his lifetime of cultivation with the Seed of Breakthrough, forging an intangible sword. That sword can only be wielded by the Breaker of the局, because it was forged using the power of the Seed of Breakthrough itself."

Chen Ji猛然想起，在天机录残页的深处，确实有一股力量一直在沉睡。他以为那只是先祖留下的知识印记，没想到——

"Where is the sword?" he asked urgently.

"Within you." The Tianji Record's main consciousness said, "The Seed of Breakthrough is the sword, the sword is the Seed of Breakthrough. They are one."

choice.prompt:
The Tianji Record's main consciousness revealed a shocking secret: the Seed of Breakthrough is the intangible sword capable of piercing high-dimensional existences! The power within Chen Ji's body was far greater than he ever imagined. But at the same time, the Tianji Record's main consciousness also revealed unsettling news—the true purpose of the Fate Twins Plan is to completely fuse Chen Ji and Ye Qing's souls, creating a new vessel capable of containing the Eye of Heavenly Dao's full power.

"The Eye of Heavenly Dao never intended for the Fate Twins to defeat it. It was preparing a new body for itself. And you, Chen Ji, are its chosen vessel."

choices.text: Accept fate, go against the grain
choices.description: Since the Eye of Heavenly Dao wants to turn you into a vessel, turn the tables. You proactively fuse with Ye Qing, then in the instant of fusion, devour the Eye of Heavenly Dao's consciousness—this is a gamble, but also the fastest path to breaking the局.
choices.visible_reward: May break the chains in one stroke
choices.risk_hint: Success rate less than thirty percent

text.content:
Chen Ji沉默了很长时间。

将计就计，反其道而行——这是他最擅长的策略。既然天道之眼想把他变成容器，那他就在成为容器的那一刻，反过来吞噬天道之眼的意识。

但这太危险了。

"成功率有多少？"他问。

"如果只有你一个人，不足一成。"天机录本体的声音中带着一丝沉重，"但如果有夜清的配合——她是被天道之眼选中的另一个容器，你们的灵魂本就同源。联手之下，成功率可以提升到三成。"

三成。

陈机的嘴角勾起一抹冷笑。三成的成功率，已经比他预想的高太多了。在这个万载棋局中，他无数次用低于一成的胜算翻盘，三成——足够他放手一搏。

choices.memory_label: 决定与夜清联手豪赌破局

choices.description: 三成成功率太低了。你需要更多时间准备，寻找其他破局的方法。天道之眼布局万年，你没有理由不能用更长的时间来瓦解它。
choices.visible_reward: More thorough preparation, higher chance of success
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao will not give you much time

text.content:
Chen Ji did not make a decision immediately.

A thirty percent success rate—that number circled endlessly in his mind. Too low. Even he had no confidence in escaping unscathed with such a low probability.

"Is there another way?" he asked.

"There is." The Tianji Record's本体 paused for a moment. "But every method requires time. And the Eye of Heavenly Dao will not give you much time. The Destiny Twins Plan has already begun. Once Ye Qing completes the fusion, you will lose your last ally. By then, you will face the full power of the Eye of Heavenly Dao alone."

Chen Ji closed his eyes and began calculating rapidly.

Time. The one thing he lacked most. Heavenly Fate was draining away, the death countdown was accelerating, and Ye Qing's destiny remained an unknown variable. In this situation, advancing steadily sounded beautiful, but was incredibly difficult to execute in practice.

Yet he still chose to wait.

Because he knew better than anyone—rashness is the precursor to failure. Without absolute certainty, he would not take that step lightly.

choices.memory_label: 决定稳扎稳打寻找其他方法

text.content:
At that moment, a violent tremor erupted from the depths of his Mental Sea.

The Tianji Record's本体 voice turned urgent: "It's here!"

"What?"

"The Eye of Heavenly Dao! It sensed our conversation!" The Tianji Record's voice carried unprecedented tension. "It's attempting to invade your Mental Sea through the Tianji Record's connection!"

Chen Ji felt a terrifying pressure bearing down from the void. It was not spiritual power suppression, not divine sense crushing—it was a force of a higher order—as if an invisible eye was peering through countless layers of void, staring fixedly at him.

"Chen Ji..." A cold voice rang out in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, devoid of any emotion, yet causing his soul to tremble.

Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply.

That was neither the Tianji Record's本体 voice nor Mo Xiansheng's voice. That voice carried no emotion, no fluctuation, like stating a simple fact. But it was precisely this coldness that sent a bone-deep chill through Chen Ji.

The Eye of Heavenly Dao.

It had truly come.

"The Breaking Potential Seed..." the cold voice continued, as if examining an interesting toy. "After ten thousand years, I see it again. The legacy left by that traitor of the Chen family—I thought it had been extinguished long ago. I never expected someone would be foolish enough to activate it."

Chen Ji steadied his mind and sneered: "Foolish? I think it's you 'Heavens' who are too arrogant."

"Arrogant?" A hint of amusement appeared in that voice. "Perhaps. But you know what? It was precisely your arrogance—or rather, your ancestor's arrogance—that allowed me to obtain what I wanted. The Breaking Potential Seed, what a ridiculous name. From the moment of its creation, it has been part of my plan."

dialogue.content: (The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice echoed in the Mental Sea)... You think you're rebelling, but you're merely acting according to the script I wrote. That traitor's choice ten thousand years ago was also within my calculations. Without him, the Breaking Potential Seed would not have fused with the bloodline; without bloodline inheritance, the Breaking Potential Seed would not have fused with you; without you, the Breaking Potential Seed would never have grown strong enough to open the Heavenly Summit. Everything, proceeding according to plan.

text.content:
Chen Ji felt his blood nearly freeze.

The Eye of Heavenly Dao's words were like a bucket of ice water, extinguishing the last spark of hope in his heart. If what it said was true, then all his resistance, all his arrangements, all his efforts—were merely part of its plan.

"You're lying." He gritted his teeth. "Your purpose is to make me despair, to make me give up resistance. But I won't—"

"Lying?" A hint of a smile appeared in that voice. "Do you know why the Breaking Potential Seed resonates with the Tianji Record? Because they are forces of the same origin. The Tianji Record is my tool—but is the Breaking Potential Seed any different? They are like two sides of the same coin, and you—"

The voice paused: "You are the perfect vessel I have chosen."

The pressure in the Mental Sea intensified sharply. Chen Ji felt his consciousness being stripped away bit by bit.

"No..." He struggled desperately, yet found his soul firmly gripped by an invisible hand, completely unable to move.

"Struggling is useless." The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice softened, yet became even more terrifying. "From the moment you activated the Breaking Potential Seed, you were destined to become part of me. Don't worry, I won't make you disappear. Your consciousness, your memories, everything about you will achieve eternity within my body. This is glory, not punishment."

Chen Ji's vision began to blur, his consciousness fading bit by bit.

Could it be... truly over?

Just as Chen Ji was about to lose consciousness, a brilliant light erupted from the depths of his Mental Sea.

That light dispersed the invisible force pressing down on him, restoring his control over his body. He abruptly opened his eyes to see a familiar figure appear in his Mental Sea—

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul.

No, not just Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul. Behind Mo Xiansheng stood a vague silhouette. That figure's outline bore some resemblance to Chen Ji, and the sharpness between its brows was even more striking.

"Ancestor..." Chen Ji murmured.

That was the Chen family ancestor who had planted the Breaking Potential Seed ten thousand years ago—his soul's residual shadow, awakened at this most critical moment.

dialogue.content:
(Chen Ji's voice trembled)... Ancestor, you were here all along?

(The vague silhouette smiled faintly)... Ten thousand years ago, I sealed a wisp of my will into the bloodline for this moment. Everything it said is true—the Breaking Potential Seed does share the same origin as the Tianji Record, because they were created for each other. But it forgot one thing: forces of the same origin can either fuse or annihilate. And you, Chen Ji, have the right to choose the manner of annihilation.

text.content:
Chen Ji's eyes reddened slightly.

Ten thousand years ago, the ancestor paved the way for future generations with his own life. Ten thousand years later, the ancestor's soul remnant awakened at the critical moment of life and death, only to tell him one thing—he had the right to choose.

Not to passively accept fate, not to act according to a preset script, but to truly and actively make a choice.

Even if that choice meant mutual destruction.

"Ancestor, I understand." Chen Ji took a deep breath, his eyes rekindling with sharp light. "Rest assured, I will never let your sacrifice be in vain. The Eye of Heavenly Dao wants to make me a vessel? Then I'll let it know—a vessel with a time bomb inside will explode."

In the Mental Sea, the Eye of Heavenly Dao's pressure intensified sharply.

"Foolish." A hint of anger appeared in that cold voice. "You think a mere mortal's意志 can oppose my existence?"

"I am not opposing you." Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet, his eyes flashing with determination. "I am choosing. Choosing to drive you out of this realm, choosing to let everyone's fate be written by themselves."

He raised his head,直视 the invisible giant eye in the void: "Didn't you say the Breaking Potential Seed shares the same origin as the Tianji Record? Very well, now I'll show you what results the same-origin forces can truly bring."

Chen Ji formed seals with both hands, simultaneously activating the Breaking Potential Seed within his body and the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea.

In an instant, two forces surged wildly within him. The golden radiance of the Breaking Potential Seed intertwined with the Tianji Record's source power, forming a massive vortex. That vortex rotated and expanded ceaselessly, as if it would devour the entire Mental Sea.

"You're mad!" For the first time, the Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice showed fluctuation. "You're destroying yourself!"

"No." Chen Ji revealed a cold smile. "I am being reborn."

Light devoured everything.

Chen Ji felt his consciousness drifting in endless energy, with no up or down, no left or right, no passage of time. He seemed to be in a void, surrounded only by golden light particles flowing gently.

"Is it over?" he thought.

But at that moment, a voice sounded in his ear—

"Not yet."

That voice was aged and weary, yet carried a hint of relief. Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes to find himself in a peculiar space. All around was endless starlight, beneath his feet was void earth, and in the distance, a massive scroll floated suspended in the void.

That was—the Tianji Record's本体.

dialogue.content: (The Tianji Record's本体 voice echoed in the void)... Welcome to the Tianji Record's core space. Breaker, you have proven your qualification. Now, you have the right to make the final choice.

text.content:
Chen Ji looked around, finding his form incomparably tiny in this space. But he felt no fear—instead, he sensed an unprecedented tranquility.

The chess game spanning ten thousand years, countless fates—all converged upon him at this moment. The ancestor's expectations, Ye Qing's destiny, Su Qingyao's protection, Mo Xiansheng's sacrifice—everything pressed upon his shoulders.

But he would not retreat.

Because he had known from the start—this path could only be walked.

"Speak." He raised his head,直视 that scroll floating in the void, the Tianji Record's本体. "What is the final choice?"

The Tianji Record's本体 voice echoed through the void with a solemn meaning:

"There are two choices."

"First: Accept all my power and merge with me. You will gain abilities surpassing the Eye of Heavenly Dao and become the new sovereign of this realm. But the price is—you will never be able to leave this scroll. Your existence will be bound to the Tianji Record until eternity."

"Second: Refuse fusion, preserve your independent consciousness. I will seal my core power within your bloodline, allowing you to use its strength throughout your lifetime. But your power will be limited—you will need to find other methods to deal with the Eye of Heavenly Dao."

Chen Ji fell silent.

The first choice meant eternal power, but also eternal binding. He would become the new Eye of Heavenly Dao, yet could no longer exist as a human.

The second choice meant freedom, but also more challenges and unknowns. He would need to face the Eye of Heavenly Dao alone, with no guarantee of success.

"Is there a third choice?" he suddenly spoke.

The Tianji Record's本体 was silent for a moment: "...There is. But it requires a greater price."

"Speak."

"Break the Eye of Heavenly Dao itself." A hint of respect appeared in the Tianji Record's voice. "Not replacing it, not fusing with it, but completely destroying its existence. But to accomplish this, you need to gather the power of all Breakers—the soul fragments of all prophecy-makers devoured by the Eye of Heavenly Dao over the millennia. This is an almost impossible task."

A slow smile curved Chen Ji's lips.

"Impossible to complete?" Sharp light flickered in his eyes. "Do you know who I am? I am Chen Ji. The废物 disciple of Tianqing Sect, the joke背负 seven hundred chapters of death prophecies, the ant everyone thought wouldn't survive three chapters."

He stepped forward, voice carrying incomparable pride: "Yet just such a废物 has turned the tables countless times with less than ten percent odds, slapped the faces of everyone who looked down on me, and played the three major sects and Demonic Path like instruments."

"Impossible to complete?" He sneered. "I love nothing more than turning the impossible into possible."

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji's declaration echoed through the void)... I choose the third option. Break the Eye of Heavenly Dao, liberate all trapped souls, let this realm's fate truly rest in the hands of the world. This is the ancestor's dying wish, also my Chen Ji's lifelong pursuit. Even if it means destruction, I will have no regrets!

text.content:
The Tianji Record's本体 fell silent for a very long time.

Finally, its voice sounded again, carrying an emotion it had never shown before—that was relief, anticipation, and determination:

"Excellent. Breaker, you have not disappointed me."

The massive scroll in the void slowly unfurled. Countless golden characters flew from its pages, transforming into streams of light that entered Chen Ji's body. At that moment, he felt his connection to this realm become unprecedentedly intimate.

He saw.

He saw all the souls trapped within fate over ten thousand years—the prophecy-makers devoured by the Eye of Heavenly Dao, the pioneers who sacrificed themselves opposing the Heavens, the heroes who refused to submit in the long river of history. Their souls became scattered starlight, gathering around him, waiting for the day of liberation.

"Chen Ji." The Tianji Record's本体 voice sounded for the last time. "I will fall into slumber. Not annihilation, but waiting. Waiting for you to gather all conditions, waiting for you to defeat the Eye of Heavenly Dao, waiting for the day you truly break this ten-thousand-year chess game. Then, I will awaken again and witness the rebirth of this realm alongside you."

"Until then—"

A hint of a smile entered its voice: "Survive, Breaker. Let them see how far a废物 can go."

As the words fell, the Tianji Record's本体 transformed into a stream of light and entered Chen Ji's brow center. The void began to collapse, starlight began to fade, and Chen Ji's consciousness returned to his body.

Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes.

He still stood in place, the surrounding scenery unchanged. As if everything just now was merely a dream. But he knew it was not a dream.

Because he could feel—an unprecedented power now existed within him. That was the awakening of the Breaking Potential Seed, the gift from the Tianji Record's source, and the gathered will of all rebels over ten thousand years.

"Eye of Heavenly Dao..." he murmured, a cold smile curling his lips. "You set up a ten-thousand-year chess game, thinking everything under control. But you forgot one thing—"

He raised his head, his gaze penetrating the void, as if he could see that ancient giant eye spanning the ages: "Chen Ji is best at turning desperate situations into victory."

In the Mental Sea, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul slowly manifested, a relieved smile on his face: "Child, you did it."

"It's still too early." Chen Ji shook his head, his gaze deepening. "The Eye of Heavenly Dao will not take this lying down. The Destiny Twins Plan is still in progress, Ye Qing's fate remains uncertain. The true decisive battle is yet to come."

He took a deep breath and began outlining a new chess game in his heart.

Since fate had given him the chance to break his chains, he would use this chance to—

Bury the Eye of Heavenly Dao completely.

Just then, a commotion sounded in the distance. A black figure swept across the horizon, rushing toward where the Demonic Path army was stationed.

Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted.

That was—Ye Qing?

Chen Ji didn't hesitate, turning into a streak of light as he gave chase.

He had to determine Ye Qing's true stance. What was this "Fated Twin" plan really about? Was she a chess piece or an ally? What truth lay hidden behind her "betrayal"?

These questions could only be answered by asking her directly.

Above the horizon, two silhouettes streaked across the sky, one pursuing the other. In Chen Ji's heart, there was both tension and anticipation. The ten-thousand-year chess game had finally reached its final chapter, and he—Chen Ji, the Chess Breaker—would personally inscribe the ending of this last page.

Whether that ending brought life or death, he would not regret it.

Because he was Chen Ji.

He was the废物 disciple of the Tianqing Sect, the protagonist of seven hundred chapters of death prophecies, the last hope of this realm.

And more—he was the Chess Breaker who would shatter every chain.
